status: draft_for_review (D02a); feeds the annotation GUI export, not a training run
purpose: D02a: reconcile the v1 dataset annotation vocabulary (21 domain issues) with the frozen neural contract (8 issues) so an annotation maps losslessly to training targets and no equivalence is invented
derivation_basis: each relation is read from the two enum name lists plus the audit §7 findings; no equivalence is measured, and every ambiguous case carries requires_contract_decision=true rather than a silent rename

rules.beauty_vs_keep: beauty (beautiful|borderline|ugly) is NOT a keep decision: an intentional low-key or moody frame can be 'ugly' by rating and still be an explicit keep (requires a note). KEEP needs positive evidence, never 'nothing found'
rules.missing_is_not_negative: an absent annotation field means unknown/masked; it is never a negative label
rules.missing_delta_is_mask: an unexpressed direction (delta) stays masked (None); it must not be written as 0
rules.no_invented_equivalence: v1 issues that only look similar to a frozen issue are marked aggregates or no_frozen_issue, never silently renamed
